body.text: Automated matching clears intercompany balances every day instead of at period end, which removes most of the manual reconciliation effort. Earlier review moves controller checks to the point of posting, so errors are fixed while they are cheap rather than found on day nine. Together the two changes free controllers to analyze results instead of chasing status.
Start wave 1 in Q1 to reach payback in 2027
Each quarter of delay pushes payback out by about four months.

slide.title: Reusable patterns speed up the platform build

source.text: West Monroe engineering patterns, Northfield delivery plan.

body.p: Standard pipelines land data from varied sources in one common model.
Pipelines are built and changed through configuration, so new feeds take hours rather than weeks, and every change is reviewed.
Parameters define what, where and when data moves, and log every run.
Pairs with a modeling accelerator to speed up and standardize design.
Insight reaches users inside the BI workflow they already use.
Blended GUI and notebook steps orchestrate data movement end to end.
Northfield keeps the pipelines, templates and tests to support future migrations, so each wave starts further ahead.
Existing cloud skills carry over, so the move to the new tooling is smooth.
Faster build, less rework and consistent controls.
